lane: main-remaining public/blog/auth/guest and two cross-lane ST-024 export views
snapshot: Only source H 55174d48cd4dc6c315d7595d982749994ad1cdbe. No fresh runtime evidence for 6b937 or later. No setup rerun or prior reviews modified.
method: Independent visual inspection of actual main PNGs at all three widths, read approved design sheets by source/family, checked matching hashes, role and capture sidecar, selected additional scrolled-controls PNGs for below-fold content. Roles and public chrome assessed by visible route (never assume an owner session role equals a public visitor). The disabled/emergency/HTTP scenarios retain their controls and fault disclosures; no browser rerun.
scopeNotes: Only 198 PB main captured records and 6 separately labeled ST-024 captures. 18 main PB selector/flow failures excluded; separate dedicated or newer runs can supersede these without rewriting their history. No request to create missing HTTP-only pages.

PB-003 shared reauthentication surface now has settled opaque forms and an actual error over retained owner context at all widths. This closes H shared-form settled appearance; does not recertify Git overlay focus in the earlier uncommitted author build.
Frontend delta H→6b937 includes setup, Git feedback, editor selections. No active browser/editor selection in inspected public content is asserted as fresh latest-source proof.

SSR checks show the different journal/magazine/profile layouts, owner-configured title/description and green brand/accent, desktop/mobile behavior. apps/server/blog/render.ts:73-74,164-166 and styles.ts implement theme/template/font/width/cards plus brand-accent. Current three screenshots use their actual fixture values. Alternative font systems, all custom values/dark themes, and third-party network or OS features were not exercised. RSS, sitemap, media and PB-060 are HTTP payloads, without an app-owned screenshot here. ST-024 modal captures do not test downloaded archive integrity.
A 0-outerOverflow result alone does not prove focused controls appear above sticky bars. Several controls become visible with further manual scrolling, so no claim of an irrecoverable pointer trap.

Shared fixture data accumulate between widths (for example 5/20/35 article totals); similar repeated names are data, not a duplicate-item defect. No latest-release claim, no mutated source/harness/sidecar, no live browser or services.

GUEST-BADGE.finding: 320 编辑模式下“可编辑”徽标换行到标题栏底边之外，后续第一排模式按钮盖住徽标下半部。读者看不完整当前权限。

STUDIO-FEEDBACK.finding: 手机保存后停在滚动表单和固定保存栏；失败和 CAS 冲突错误/核对按钮都在高处。当前视口仍只写有未保存修改，控件图也没有错误。

NETWORK-TEXT.finding: 真实断网时桌面返回 Failed to fetch 给中文用户。没有说明此次保存失败及可执行的恢复步骤。

FOCUS-COVERED.finding: 默认聚焦滚动后若干真实输入、下拉或排序按钮仍在粘性保存栏下面。可继续手动滚动，未判定永久不可达；图片 file input/透明包装和 0×0 隐藏节点不作为本结论的依据。

LOW-DANGER-CONTRAST.finding: 已启用的红色放弃按钮在白底的实测文字比 4.466（目标 4.5），保留/放弃两个按钮都可达。

OAUTH-ALERT-SAMPLE.finding: 容器探测 3.554；画面中的内层字形显著更深，不能把容器计算值当作字形实际比值，也不能据此断言已通过对比度。需采直接文本节点样式。

OAUTH-RETRY-STYLE.finding: 唯一重试动作使用细边次级样式并紧贴错误框，MP-S046/R053 给出主色重试。

LOADING-MISMATCH.finding: 320 目标页面主图仅有正在加载博客。articles/taxonomy 控件图仍加载；design 控件图仍在读取装修配置；settings 辅图只覆盖页面下段，不替代完整主状态。

SHARE-ABORT-MISMATCH.finding: 应静默的取消分支实际呈现复制后备状态。只认截图中的反馈；未据此推断实际系统分享取消行为。

OAUTH-BRANCH.finding: 主图为旧式操作/目录授权，不能覆盖现代业务预设；原 sourceIds PB-018 与可见分支不同。

COVER-CLOSED.finding: PB-032 文章信息已显示；同时映射的 PB-034 原稿附件封面选择未展开。本行不能充当附件选择证据。

HIDDEN-NODE.finding: 保留内部节点、文件代理等探针异常，但其数值单独不足以证明使用者不能与可见控件交互。

DRAFT-REMOVE-COPY.finding: 所选草稿明确“还未公开发布”，移除确认却称“公开文章将无法访问”。建议针对未发布选稿采用准确影响说明。

CROP-COLOR.finding: 单色测试图可查控件布局，不能视觉确认裁切图像内容变化。

EXPORT-ERROR-CODE.finding: 受控未知 503 原样展示内部错误码；可增加通用中文失败说明。此图不足以证明真实生产错误使用相同代码。
